text:
jordan: FYI planning to unpin runtime 2.15 -> 2.16 in eu-west tomorrow at 02:00 UTC. Noticed an interaction with the autoscaler where scale-to-zero during soft-unpin can trigger a stale-kv fallback. Want to surface before we flip the switch.
lia: thanks. do we have telemetry showing scale-to-zero frequency during that window?
priya: quick note — runtime 2.16 changes KV cache eviction timing. If pods scale to 0 and come back, older model containers may request a cold KV warmup which the older runtime rejects -> 503.
maya: oof that matches a couple of incidents last week where we saw elevated 503s after a nightly scale down. autoscaler events line up.
sre-oncall: can we prevent scale-to-zero for the rollout window? what's the impact on cost?
jordan: we can request a temporary min-replicas=1 in the HPA patch for eu-west for 3 hours around the change, cost impact negligible for that window. Proposal: min=1 from 01:30 -> 04:00 UTC, unpin at 02:00, monitor for 45m, then relax.
priya: also recommend a deploybot soft-pin during warmup: add runtime 2.15 -> 2.16 soft-pin for model group 'llama3q' for 30m post-unpin to force routing to runtime 2.16 where available, fallback to 2.15 only if latency spikes.
lia: sounds good. action items: 1) @deploybot add HPA override for eu-west 01:30-04:00. 2) @priya publish compatibility note in release notes about KV eviction and scale-to-zero. 3) @sre-oncall observe metrics: 50th/95th latency, 503 count, kv-warmups.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled action created: set hpa.minReplicas=1 for service/runtime-eu-west from 1769997000 to 1769998800. Reaction :white_check_mark:.
sre-oncall: I can monitor. I'll add an alert for kv-cold-warmup-rate > 5/min and page if 503 spike > 2x baseline for 5m.
maya: can we also add a temporary routing rule: prefer instances with runtime=2.16 tag for the first 20m? lowers fallback churn.
priya: yes, I'll push a rollout policy: weight 80% to 2.16, 20% to 2.15 for 20m, then 100% 2.16 if stable. I'll attach the exact deploybot command in the release notes snippet.
jordan: rollback criteria: if 95th latency > +200ms or 503 rate > 2x baseline for 10m, we pin back to 2.15 and rollback runtime 2.16. Priya, liaison on executing?
priya: I'll own the rollback. Keep the pin command ready: `deploybot pin runtime 2.15 --scope eu-west --reason rollback-on-503`.
lia: I'll update the release checklist with the HPA override and the rollout weights. Also adding a reminder for docs/ops-runbooks.
deploybot: deploybot: rollout policy applied: 80/20 2.16->2.15 for model-group llama3q, window 20m.
sre-oncall: monitoring dashboard linked: https://grafana/redwood/runtime-eu-west-rollout (please don't open during dinner :grimacing:).
maya: small test suggestion: run a controlled scale-to-zero in staging with a 80/20 routing to verify KV warmup behavior before prod.
priya: agreed, I'll schedule a staging test tonight at 23:00 UTC and post results.
jordan: final call: proceeding with the plan unless anyone objects in next 30m. If no objections, I'll mark the release notes and schedule the HPA override.
lia: 👍 no objections from platform side.
sre-oncall: 👍 I'll be up on pager for the window.
priya: 👍 will post staging test results and the release note blurb.
(30 minutes later) priya: staging test: observed one cold-warmup 503 in staging, but routing-weight fix prevented broad failures. Logs: ```2026-02-18T23:02:12Z runtime(2.15)->request KV miss -> 503``` Will add note to release notes and we should be good to proceed.
jordan: thanks — rolling forward with the plan.
